instruction: Change the subject of this email to 'December 2023 AWS Invoice'.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully attached aws-bill.pdf to Thunderbird compose email in 5 turns. Clicked Attach button, navigated to Home directory, selected aws-bill.pdf, clicked Open.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with Thunderbird compose window UI: toolbar buttons, file dialogs, file selection. Navigates file browser and attaches files.
metadata.task_rationale: Since the agent proved it can interact with compose window fields, this variation tests editing the subject field — a related but different compose window interaction.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the email subject line. Evaluator uses xdotool to read the compose window title (format: 'Write: {subject} - Thunderbird') and checks it contains the expected subject.

scoring_breakdown.subject_match: 1.0 - Compose window title contains 'December 2023 AWS Invoice'

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses xdotool to read Thunderbird compose window title (format 'Write: {subject} - Thunderbird'), which reflects the current subject line.
Metric correctly accesses expected.get('expected_subject') — proper handling for type='rule' where expected IS the rules dict.
Case-insensitive substring check is appropriate for matching subject within the window title string.
Expected value 'December 2023 AWS Invoice' exactly matches the instruction requirement.
Postconfig activates the Thunderbird window before evaluation, ensuring xdotool can find the compose window.
Single-requirement instruction is fully covered by the evaluator — no missing checks.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: xdotool 'head -1' assumes only one compose window exists. If multiple compose windows are open, it may read the wrong one. Consider filtering more specifically, though this is unlikely given the task setup.
